message.content:
This document is a technical README/study for **Project Maya**, an inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) with experimental AMD HIP support. Key points:

**Models & Quants**
- Maya quant tiers (XS/S/M/L) named by model + bits-per-expert; GLM-5.3-Flash quants range 94.7–156.3 GB, retaining 97.7–99.2% of FP8 accuracy.
- DeepSeek
